description_expanded:
Ideally situated between the Caliza Pool Complex and ZUMA Wellness center and just a short walk from the Town Center, this Alys Beach home was created to make memories. With 5 bedrooms and 4.5 baths, this beach vacation rental makes it easy to share the experience. Evocative Moroccan interior design complements equally stirring architecture to create the perfect beach getaway. The first floor features living and dining areas that open to the kitchen, all flooded with natural light. Entry loggia is ideal for al fresco dining. The landscaped courtyard includes a heated pool, all open to a kitchen with well-appointed pantry. Guest primary suite on first floor has its own courtyard. There’s a large primary suite on the second floor along with 2 additional bedrooms and a bonus room including 1 double bed and 1 twin bed. The home features a large outdoor television and speaker system in the courtyard. Parking for this home is in a two-car garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding 84 Nonesuch Way. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
